text: The geometric realisation–singular complex adjunction |·| ⊣ Sing establishes:
choices: an equivalence between simplicial sets and topological spaces
a Quillen equivalence between the Kan-Quillen model structure on sSet and the Quillen model structure on Top
that every topological space is a simplicial set
that Kan complexes are the same as CW complexes
explanation: |·| ⊣ Sing is a Quillen equivalence between (sSet, Kan-Quillen) and (Top, Quillen). Weak homotopy equivalences in Top correspond exactly to weak equivalences in sSet.
